name: day-trader-skill-india
description: The Day Trader skill pack for Claude, adapted for NSE intraday trading

plugins.name: day-trader-skill-india
plugins.description: Nine Claude skills for NSE intraday trading: a chart scanner (Nifty 500 or all EQ stocks), a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner on the NSE tick, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager in rupees, an order ticket desk (manual broker mode, never without your yes) and price alerts on the NSE clock.
